_note: A prompt longer than any context window, to record the context error. The script pads the last user message to about 600,000 characters (far over a 16k-token window, under TUFF's 5 MiB request limit) and removes both underscore keys. TUFF starts the stream first and sends the error inside it; record it once with the model loaded and once with the server idle.
